Add the smoke set: 23 tagged tests, a manual workflow and a dashboard family

use.userAgent: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/156.0.8078.4 Safari/537.36

specs.title: API-0119: List brands returns the brands

steps.title: Send GET /brands.
Verify the response status is 200.
Verify the body is a non-empty array.
Verify every item has a non-empty string id, name and slug.

specs.title: API-0114: Add a product with quantity 1 to a cart returns 200 and the cart holds it

steps.title: Send GET /products and take the first item's brand id, category id and product image id.
Send POST /products with a unique product name, a positive price, those ids, is_location_offer false, is_rental false and stock 10, and take the new product's id.
Send POST /carts with an empty body and take the returned id as the cart's id.
Send POST /carts/{cartId} with the cart's id and a body with the new product's id as product_id and quantity 1.
Verify the response status is 200.
Verify the body's result is "item added or updated".
Verify GET /carts/{cartId} with the cart's id returns 200.
Verify its cart_items has exactly one item, with the new product's id as product_id and quantity 1.

specs.title: API-0178: Category tree returns the top-level categories with their sub-categories

steps.title: Send GET /categories/tree.
Verify the response status is 200.
Verify the body is a non-empty array and every item's parent_id is null.
Verify the body's slugs include hand-tools, power-tools and other.
Verify every item has a sub_categories array, and every sub-category's parent_id equals its item's id.

specs.title: API-0272: Add favorite returns 201 with the new favorite

steps.title: Send POST /users/register with a unique email, a first name, a last name and a random strong password, and take the new user's id.
Send POST /users/login with that email and password, and take its access_token.
Send GET /products and take the first item's id.
Send POST /favorites with that product id and the throwaway customer's access_token, and take the new favorite's id.
Verify the response status is 201.
Verify the body's product_id equals the product id sent.
Verify the body has a non-empty id.
Verify the body's user_id equals the new user's id.
Verify GET /favorites/{favoriteId} with the new id and the throwaway customer's access_token returns 200 with the same product_id and user_id.

specs.title: API-0615: Check credit card details returns 200

steps.title: Send POST /payment/check without an Authorization header, with payment_method "credit-card" and payment_details { credit_card_number: "1234-5678-9101-1121", expiration_date: the same month next year in m/Y form, cvv: "123", card_holder_name: "Jane Doe" }.
Verify the response status is 200.
Verify the body's message is "Payment was successful".

specs.title: API-0643: Look up a Dutch postcode returns the address

steps.title: Send GET /postcode-lookup without an Authorization header, with country "NL", postcode "1011AB" and house_number "5".
Verify the response status is 200.
Verify the Content-Type header starts with "application/json".
Verify the body has the keys street, house_number, city, state, country and postcode, and each value is a string.
Verify the body's country is "NL".
Verify the body's postcode is "1011AB".
Verify the body's house_number is "5".

specs.title: API-0020: Get product returns the product with its category, brand, image and specs

steps.title: Send GET /products and take the first item's id and name.
Send GET /products/{productId} with that id.
Verify the response status is 200.
Verify the body's id equals that id and its name equals that name.
Verify the body has description, price, is_location_offer, is_rental, co2_rating, in_stock, is_eco_friendly, product_image, and a brand with id and name.
Verify the category has id, name, slug and parent_id.
Verify specs is an array and every spec has id, product_id, spec_name, spec_value and spec_unit.
Verify in_stock is a boolean.

specs.title: API-0001: Search by name returns only matching products

steps.title: Send GET /products/search with q=pliers.
Verify the response status is 200 and the body is paginated (data, total, current_page).
Verify total is greater than 0 and every item's name contains "pliers" (case-insensitive).
Verify each item has an id, a name and a price greater than 0.

specs.title: API-0002: List products returns the first page of non-rental products

steps.title: Send GET /products without query parameters.
Verify the response status is 200.
Verify the body has current_page, data, from, last_page, per_page, to and total.
Verify current_page is 1 and per_page is 9.
Verify data has at most 9 items.
Verify each item has id, name, description, price, is_location_offer, is_rental, co2_rating, in_stock, is_eco_friendly, product_image, a category with id, name and slug, and a brand with id and name.
Verify every item's is_rental is false.
Verify every item's in_stock is a boolean.
Verify every item's is_eco_friendly is true exactly when its co2_rating is A or B.

specs.title: API-0004: Filter by category returns only that category's products

steps.title: Send GET /products and take the category id of the first item.
Send GET /products with by_category set to that category id.
Verify the response status is 200.
Verify data is not empty and every item's category id equals that category id.

specs.title: API-0033: Create product returns 201 with the new product

steps.title: Send GET /products and take the first item's brand id, category id and product image id.
Send POST /products with a unique product name, a positive price, that category id, brand id and product image id, is_location_offer false and is_rental false.
Verify the response status is 201.
Verify the body has a non-empty id.
Verify the body's name and price equal the values sent, and its is_location_offer and is_rental are false.
Verify the body's category id, brand id and product_image id equal the ids sent.
Verify GET /products/{productId} with the new id returns 200 with the same name.

specs.title: API-0063: Current user endpoint returns the logged-in user's profile

steps.title: Send GET /users/me with the default user's token.
Verify the response status is 200.
Verify email equals the default user's email, and id, first_name and last_name are not empty.

specs.title: API-0100: Current user endpoint returns the admin-only fields to an admin

steps.title: Send GET /users/me with the admin's token.
Verify the response status is 200.
Verify the body's role is "admin".
Verify the body's enabled is a boolean and failed_login_attempts is a number.

specs.title: API-0402: List users as an admin returns 200 with a page of customers

steps.title: Send GET /users with the admin's token.
Verify the response status is 200.
Verify the body has the keys current_page, data, from, last_page, per_page, to and total, and its per_page is 15.
Verify data has 1 to 15 items and every item's role is "user".

specs.title: API-0078: Login returns 200 with a bearer token

steps.title: Send POST /users/login with the default user's email and password.
Verify the response status is 200.
Verify the body's access_token is a non-empty string.
Verify the body's token_type is "bearer".
Verify the body's expires_in is 300.
Verify GET /users/me with the new access_token returns 200 with the default user's email.

specs.title: API-0085: Register returns 201 with the new customer

steps.title: Send POST /users/register with a unique email, a first name, a last name and a random strong password.
Verify the response status is 201.
Verify the body has a non-empty id and a non-empty created_at.
Verify the body's first_name, last_name and email equal the values sent.
Verify the body has an address object.
Verify POST /users/login with that email and password returns 200, and GET /users/me with its access_token returns the new id and email.

specs.title: UI-002: Add a product with quantity 2 to the cart

steps.title: Create a product for this test through the API: a unique name, in stock.
Set the quantity to 2 and click "Add to cart".
Verify the cart badge in the nav bar shows 2.
Open the cart.
Verify the cart has exactly one line: that product with quantity 2.
Verify the cart total equals 2 × the product's unit price.

specs.title: UI-013: The product page shows the product's information and related products

steps.title: Verify the product image is shown.
Verify the name "Combination Pliers" is shown.
Verify the product description is shown.
Verify the price "$14.15" is shown.
Verify the category badge "Pliers" is shown.
Verify the brand badge "ForgeFlex Tools" is shown.
Verify the "Related products" section is shown below the product information.
Verify the "Related products" section shows at least one product.

specs.title: UI-028: Adding a product to favourites shows a success message

steps.title: Click "Add to favourites".
Verify the message "Product added to your favorites list." is shown.

specs.title: UI-075: Checking a category shows only that category's products

steps.title: Check the category "Pliers" in the sidebar.
Verify the grid shows only the products of the category "Pliers": the products the catalogue lists for it in the page's default price range, $1 to $100.

specs.title: UI-070: The home page shows a grid of product cards with an image, a name and a price

steps.title: Verify the product grid shows at least one product card.
Verify every card shows a product image.
Verify every card shows a product name.
Verify every card shows a price.

specs.title: UI-071: Clicking a product card opens that product's page

steps.title: Click the card of "Combination Pliers".
Verify the product detail page is shown.
Verify the name "Combination Pliers" is shown.

specs.title: UI-001: Search by name shows only matching products

steps.title: Search for "pliers".
Verify the caption reads "Searched for: pliers".
Verify at least one product is shown.
Verify every product name contains "pliers" (case-insensitive).
